description: Inserts a part or assembly file into an assembly as a component, at a point (mm, assembly coordinates; the assembly origin by default) with its axes aligned to the assembly's unless x_axis and z_axis are given. The first component of an empty assembly is fixed unless fixed is false; later ones float unless fixed is true. Checked: one more component, of that file and configuration, where it was asked to be; otherwise it is removed again. Returns its reference (r1.component.…): opaque, pass it back exactly as given.

document.description: The assembly: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

path.description: Full path of an existing .SLDPRT or .SLDASM file.

configuration.description: The configuration of the file to use; its active configuration when absent.

at.description: Where the component's origin goes, mm in the assembly. The assembly origin when absent.

x_axis.description: The component's x axis in the assembly, with z_axis (both or neither, perpendicular). The assembly's x axis when absent.

z_axis.description: The component's z axis in the assembly, with x_axis. The assembly's z axis when absent.

fixed.description: Fix it in place. Default: true for the first component of an empty assembly, false otherwise.
